_comment: Win-reason taxonomy (Phase 7, item 0; extended for the competitive-content engine). Why competitors beat QC head-to-head, normalized from free-text win_reasons. Matched in order, first hit wins. 'addressable': can published content close this gap? false = structural (content can't manufacture reputation or a first-mention slot). 'action_type': content = a page QC could publish; citation = the fix is earning third-party proof, not writing a page (out of scope for the BUILD-shaped competitive-content engine, which only acts on action_type 'content'). 'probe' drives the content-index search the same way concern_taxonomy.json's probe does.
